backend/main.mo: Defines the main canister actor with persistent state for authorization, storage, profiles, pairing, schedules, filters, activity logs, and admin password, along with all related types.
backend/migration.mo: Handles migration for admin password, updating it only if it matches the old stored value.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing frontend files and components involved in updating admin password verification behavior.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of various frontend files describing their roles in authentication, admin flow, dashboards, and UI behavior.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light and dark theme variables and applying global styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document setting up metadata, favicon, and mounting point for the React app.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: Web app manifest defining app metadata, icons, theme colors, and display mode for PWA support.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker providing caching, fetch handling, and background sync for queued location updates.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component handling authentication, admin gate logic, role-based routing, presence heartbeat, and overall app layout.
frontend/src/components/account/AccountD: User account dropdown with options to change photo, password, view policies, or delete the account, with role labeling and dialogs.
frontend/src/components/account/ChangePa: Displays a dialog explaining password management via Internet Identity and links users to open the II portal.
frontend/src/components/account/ChangePr: Allows users to upload, preview, save, or remove a profile photo with validation and upload progress.
frontend/src/components/account/DeleteAc: Provides a confirmation dialog for deleting an account requiring typing DELETE and handles deletion state and errors.
frontend/src/components/account/UserAvat: Renders a user avatar using a profile photo or generated initials with configurable sizes.
frontend/src/components/admin/AccountsTa: Empty placeholder for an accounts table component.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminPassw: Implements admin password verification and password change workflows with tabs and validation.
frontend/src/components/admin/Aggregated: Displays admin dashboard metric cards sourced from backend metrics with loading skeletons.
frontend/src/components/alerts/AlertsPan: Shows a child's daily screen-time status, alerts for limit exceedance, and a form to request more time.
Displays a parent's alert panel showing today's activity duration, compares it to the daily limit, and renders over-limit or within-limit status messages.
frontend/src/components/audit/AuditLogTa: Fetches and displays a sortable table of audit log events for a child, including action type, executor, and timestamp.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Provides a login/logout button using Internet Identity, handling authentication state, loading state, and session clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Handles user profile setup for parents, children, and admins, including phone validation and admin password verification.
frontend/src/components/child/ActivityHi: Shows a table of a child's submitted activities sorted by timestamp, with optional transparency labeling and periodic refetching.
frontend/src/components/child/ChildCheck: Allows children to submit activities and location check-ins, manage live location sharing, and handle related form interactions.
frontend/src/components/child/ConsentNot: Displays contextual consent notices for activity, location, or pairing actions using configurable icons and text.
frontend/src/components/child/LocationHi: Shows a sortable and filterable table of a child's recorded locations with map links and optional transparency labeling.
frontend/src/components/child/PairWithPa: Handles child–parent pairing via code or phone verification with validation, mutation calls, and UI states.
frontend/src/components/filters/ContentF: Provides an editor for parents to configure content categories and custom allow/block lists for a child.
Displays a child's content filter settings in a non-editable view including categories, allowlist, and blocklist.
frontend/src/components/i18n/LanguageSel: Renders a dropdown to switch application language using the i18n context.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppFooter: Shows footer with copyright, transparency policy link, and attribution to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Displays the main header with branding, theme toggle, language selector, login, and user profile controls.
frontend/src/components/parent/ActivityV: Shows a transparency notice and a child's activity history with periodic refresh.
frontend/src/components/parent/ChildSumm: Summarizes a child's recent activity and location count with selectable card UI.
frontend/src/components/parent/LiveLocat: Shows the child's latest location, recency info, and optionally live-sharing status with a link to Google Maps.
frontend/src/components/parent/LocationV: Displays a child's live map and location history with a tab selector and a consent notice.
frontend/src/components/parent/PairingSe: Generates and displays a pairing code for linking accounts, with copy-to-clipboard and warnings.
frontend/src/components/parent/ParentPho: Shows and edits the parent's phone number with validation, saving, and status alerts.
frontend/src/components/schedule/Schedul: Allows parents to edit screen‑time limits and weekly time windows and save them to the backend.
Displays read‑only screen‑time limits and allowed time windows for a child.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on identity and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminGate.ts: Manages a simple session‑based admin gate flag with set and clear functions.
frontend/src/hooks/useI18n.ts: Provides access to the i18n context for translations.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Handles Internet Identity auth state, login, logout, and persistence through a context provider.
frontend/src/hooks/useLiveLocationSharin: Hook that periodically captures geolocation, submits it, queues failed updates, and handles visibility and background sync.
Sends periodic and visibility-triggered heartbeat calls to record user presence when authenticated.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, admin checks, metrics, and various backend interactions.
frontend/src/i18n/I18nProvider.tsx: Provides i18n context with language persistence, translation lookup, and parameter substitution.
frontend/src/i18n/index.ts: Exports locale types, translation maps, and supported locales for the i18n system.
frontend/src/i18n/translations/en.ts: English translation dictionary containing UI strings for the app.
frontend/src/i18n/translations/pt-BR.ts: Brazilian Portuguese translation dictionary containing UI strings for the app.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for light and dark navy-themed design.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point setting up Internet Identity and React Query providers before rendering the app.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin dashboard displaying metrics cards and a placeholder management tab using translations.
frontend/src/pages/child/ChildHome.tsx: Child home screen with profile info, pairing prompt, and tabs for check-in, history, schedule, filters, and alerts.
frontend/src/pages/parent/ParentDashboar: Parent dashboard showing profile, pairing requests, child summaries, and tabs for activity, location, scheduling, filters, audits, and alerts.
Modal page showing translated transparency and supervision policies with multiple sections and scrollable content.
frontend/src/pwa/registerServiceWorker.t: Utility for registering a service worker and requesting background or periodic sync capabilities.
frontend/src/utils/liveLocationCapabilit: Detects device capabilities for geolocation and background updates and generates a user-facing capability message.
frontend/src/utils/locationUpdateQueue.t: LocalStorage-backed queue for batching and retrying location updates with limits and retry handling.
frontend/src/utils/phoneNumber.ts: Utility for validating, normalizing, formatting, and comparing 11‑digit phone numbers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL/search/hash parameters and persist them in sessionStorage, plus utilities to clear stored or hash-based params.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugin setup for the frontend UI.
project_state.json: Defines project state, issues, and feature requests related to admin password handling and backend migration requirements.
